name: tht-to
title: TO package, straight leads
summary: Single-row TO package: a moulded block on its standoff over a pattern of pins square leads straight down at the lead pitch (pins, lead_pitch, lead_diameter, lead_below, standoff, root, body_length, body_width, body_height, corner_round, edge_round).
provenance: Original work: the in-code through-hole builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/tht.rs, retired with this file) authored through SolidCraft's commands over plain parameters by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (saved at a TO-220-3, 10 × 4.5 × 15.5 mm, 0.8 mm leads at 2.54 mm); the tht generator gives every value. Estimated lead roots, bends and rounds; no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
